note: Pause policy of the quest board (card questresume, knob quests.resumeAfterDeaths, default 0). One row per park code that may lift itself: the hero must have been quiet for afterMin minutes (no death since the park), be at minLifePct life and not in purse recovery. A chunk resumes at most maxAutoResumes times in a row (a park that follows an automatic resume stays until the player taps Try again) and the whole board at most dayCap times in 24 hours.
